Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Baseline hosted API rates + EU residency adder for PHI workloads

Hi Priyom,

Quick question to get our procurement looped in: can you send a short baseline for Redwood hosted API pricing (per 1M tokens) for US vs EU regions, and separately call out any data-residency/sovereignty adders (we'd be storing logs and some derived artifacts for audit). We're evaluating for a proof-of-concept that will run in EU regions and need an estimate before the vendor evaluation meeting next week.

Also: any standard pass-through or invoice tagging you do for committed volumes would be helpful. Target footprint for POC is ~10M tokens/month, but we'll include a 6–12 month projection in our SOW.

Thanks,
Kelly
Kelly Turner
Head of Procurement, Aurora Health
kelly.turner@aurorahealth.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Cc: Samir Das <samir@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Baseline hosted API rates + EU residency adder for PHI workloads

Hi Kelly — thanks for the note. Quick summary below; attaching a concise rate card and a sovereignty fees matrix for line-item detail. If you want a single line comparison table for the SOW, I can produce that as well.

Summary (hosted API, per 1M tokens; USD):
- US (us-west/us-east): $23.50 / 1M tokens
- EU (europe-west): $27.75 / 1M tokens (region premium + EU infra costs)

Sovereignty / residency adders (applied on top of hosted rate when log + KV persistence is required to remain in-customer-region):
- Standard residency adder: $450/month per-region (covers encrypted KV persistence + isolated storage)
- High-compliance (audit log retention 7 yrs, dedicated KMS integration): $1,100/month per-region

Notes:
- Residency adders are billed monthly and are independent of token usage.
- We support invoice tagging and a dedicated invoice line for 'EU residency premium' for customers that require it.
- Committed volume discounts (examples below) are typically applied as a %-off list on the per-token rate, not on residency adders.

Attachments: redwood-hosted-ratecard-2027Q2.pdf (PDF, 48KB); sovereignty-fees-matrix-2027.csv (CSV, 8KB)

If you can share a target committed monthly token number for 6–12 months, I can circulate an offer with tiered discounts and a sample invoice layout.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
From: Kelly Turner <kelly.turner@aurorahealth.com>

Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Baseline hosted API rates + EU residency adder for PHI workloads

Thanks — that's helpful. Two follow-ups:
1) For the POC we're targeting a committed baseline of 10M tokens/mo, with a chance to scale to 50M/mo if the clinical validation goes well. For procurement I need to see a price with a committed-tier discount applied (20% off list for a 12-month commit was the internal target).
2) Can you confirm whether the residency adders are refundable or pro-rated upon early termination? Our legal team asks about refunds for pre-paid infra when we decommission.

Appreciate it — can we get a short deck / single-sheet with list vs committed pricing and the invoice tagging example so procurement can circulate?

Kelly
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Baseline hosted API rates + EU residency adder for PHI workloads

Laura / Neha — looping you in. Aurora (healthcare customer) asked for a 20% off list for a 12-month commit at 10M -> 50M tokens/mo scale. They need the sheet for procurement asap and clarification on whether residency adders are refundable / pro-rated on early termination.

My thinking: we can offer a stepped discount schedule (see below) and treat residency adders as recurring service fees that are pro-rated but non-refundable for the month in which service is consumed. If they prepay a year for adders, we might consider pro-rated refunds for unused full months only. Need quick OK from pricing/legal.

Proposed discount cadence (subject to approval):
- 10M–25M tokens/mo: 15% off list
- 25M–75M tokens/mo: 22% off list
- 75M+: bespoke enterprise pricing (deeper discounts, reserved capacity conversation)

If we accept 20% flat at 10M, they'd be near the 15% band but above it — we'd be giving market-leading economics for the POC. Thoughts?

-- Priyom
(Attachment: AUR-061-MAP-v2.xlsx — draft discount schedule and invoice mock)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:16:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Baseline hosted API rates + EU residency adder for PHI workloads

Thanks for the context. Approve moving forward with a short SOW-friendly offer but don't commit to 20% at 10M without a brief approval path:

- Approve the proposed stepped cadence.
- Approve one-off POC concession: up to 20% for the first 3 months (trial rate) if Aurora signs a 12-month MSA and provides a rolling 30-day notice for decommission. After month 3, revert to the cadence above unless they hit the 25M threshold.
- Residency adders: treat as monthly recurring service fees. We will pro-rate unused full months in the event of early termination; we will not provide refunds for partial-month usage or for months already consumed. Legal to add standard language into SOW.
- Require procurement to commit to a named contact and PO cadence; invoice tagging is fine (we'll show 'EU residency premium' as a separate invoice line).

Neha — please prepare a single-sheet comparing list vs trial concession (20% for first 3 months) + the invoice example. Priyom — once Neha confirms I will ok sending to customer.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, EMEA, Redwood Inference

Subject: Final POC offer: list vs trial concession + residency billing example

Hi Kelly / Samir — thanks again for the quick turnaround. Per internal approvals, please find the concise offer below and attached single-sheet (PDF) and the sovereignty matrix.

Offer (hosted API, per 1M tokens; USD):
- List (US): $23.50 / 1M tokens
- List (EU): $27.75 / 1M tokens
- Trial concession: 20% off list for first 3 months (applies to token rate only) if Aurora signs a 12-month MSA and provides a rolling 30-day notice for decommission.

Example: 10M tokens/mo POC pricing (month 1–3 with concession):
- EU list: $27.75 -> concession price $22.20 / 1M -> monthly token charge = $222.00
- Residency adder (standard): $450/month (separate invoice line: 'EU residency premium')
- Total monthly (month 1–3): $672.00 plus applicable taxes

Residency adder refund policy: pro-rated refunds for unused full months only. No refunds for partial-month consumption. We will include explicit SOW language to that effect.

Attachments: redwood-hosted-ratecard-2027Q2.pdf; sovereignty-fees-matrix-2027.csv; AUR-061-MAP-v2.xlsx

Next steps: would you be available for a 30-minute procurement + architecture call on Thu 27 May to lock the SOW language and invoice layout? Proposed times: 10:00–10:30 BST or 14:00–14:30 BST.

Best regards,
Priyom Das
